Tiwari - G.A. appearing on behalf of Adv  Shri Hardik Maheshwari, learned counsel for the res  ORDER 1] This petition under Section 528 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 / 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed by the petitioner for quashing the FIR lodged at Crime No.61/2024, registered at Police Station M.G. Road, Indore, District Indore (M.P.) against the petitioner under Sections 420, 406, 465, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC and all other subsequent proceedings arising out the aforesaid crime.
2] Learned counsel for the petitioner at the outset, has submitted that the a compromise has already been arrived at between the parties and a separate application -I.A.No.10551/2025 under Section 359 of BNSS, 2023 read with Section 320 of the Cr.P.C. has also been filed.
It is also submitted that the affidavits in this regard have also been filed on record.
Thus, it is submitted that NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:21256 2 MCRC-29696-2025 the petition deserves to be allowed.
3] Counsel for the respondent nos. 2 has submitted that the petition may be allowed.
4] Counsel for the respondent No.1/State has opposed the prayer.

5] Having considered the rival submissions, perusal of the documents filed on record, and the fact that the parties have already compromised the matter, which has also been verified by the Principal Registrar of this Court on Rajesh Kumar vs The State Of M.P. on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60501542/
1 28/07/2025, which was between the private parties only and no public interest in general was involved, and no purpose would be served to further drag the matter, this Court is inclined the allow the petition filed under Section 528 of the B.N.S.S. 6]
